\[
\sigma(x,y) = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{w \in W_{xy}} w^2 - \Bigl(\frac{1}{n} \sum_{w \in W_{xy}} w\Bigr)^2}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W_{xy}\): The window around (x, y)
- \(n\): Number of values in the window

The square root of the population variance of the window. It has the same unit as the image, so a value of 20 means the neighbors spread about 20 levels around their mean.
